Name: cantibleChaos's BFAV Yaks for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from cantibleChaos, I have converted their BFAV Yaks (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9102) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to cantibleChaos for the original mod. 

Yaks live in Barns and produce yak milk and yak fiber that can be turned into cheese and cloth. EDIT: As of 1.1.6 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Config[/url]  required so yaks will produce both milk and fiber simultaneously, thanks to help from Selph!

Enjoy!
